tournament.ko.structure.singleEliminatio: Principle: 1 loss = eliminated. Fast and simple. The loser of each match is immediately eliminated. Supports byes if the number of participants is not a power of 2. 3rd place match optionally configurable.
Single Elimination with 3rd Place Match (Bronze Match)
Like Single Elimination, but the semifinal losers play for 3rd place. Ideal when 3rd place matters (prizes, points). Bronze match separately configurable (e.g. shorter best-of than the final).
tournament.ko.structure.consolationBrack: Losers fall into a second KO bracket (consolation) to continue playing. There will be a main winner and a consolation winner. More playing time for everyone, better for participant satisfaction. Configurable from which round the consolation bracket starts.
tournament.ko.structure.doubleEliminatio: Principle: 2 losses = eliminated. There are two brackets: Winner Bracket (undefeated) and Loser Bracket (after first loss). Very fair because a single slip-up doesn't eliminate you immediately. More complex schedule, more matches. Final with optional bracket reset configurable.
tournament.ko.structure.tripleEliminatio: Principle: 3 losses = eliminated (three lives). Rare in practice, maximum fairness. Only makes sense when a lot of time is available. Final logic like Double Elimination, but with more stages.
tournament.ko.structure.aggregateKo: KO with Home and Away Legs (Aggregate KO)
tournament.ko.structure.aggregateKoDesc: Each round consists of 2 legs/matches (home and away). The winner is determined by the aggregate score. Tiebreaker in case of a tie: decider leg, sudden death, or third match. Football-inspired format.
tournament.ko.structure.groupThenSingleK: Group Stage followed by Single Elimination
First, everyone plays multiple group matches. Then the best players advance to a classic KO round. Typical for major tournaments (World Cup, Euros).
tournament.ko.structure.groupThenDoubleK: Group Stage followed by Double Elimination
After the Group Stage, you can afford one loss in the Knockout Phase as well. Combines Group Stage with a double elimination system.
tournament.ko.structure.koWithGroupAdvan: KO with Advantage for Group Winners
Whoever wins their group gets a bonus in the Knockout Phase as a reward for good performance in the Group Stage.
tournament.ko.structure.pagePlayoffDesc: The best participants have an advantage and can afford one loss, while others cannot. Special system for small participant fields.
tournament.ko.draw.fullRandomDesc: All participants are randomly paired. No pre-sorting or seeding rules. Anyone can face anyone.
tournament.ko.draw.fullRandomQualifiedDe: All qualified participants are randomly paired, regardless of group placement or Group Stage performance.
tournament.ko.draw.potSystemDesc: Participants are divided into strength pots (e.g. based on world ranking or previous performance) and then drawn with rules. Stronger participants meet later.
tournament.ko.draw.potSystemGroupDesc: Participants are divided into pots based on Group Stage performance and then drawn. Group Stage results feed into the pot assignment.
tournament.ko.draw.manualKODesc: The pairings for the first KO round are set manually. Available in the tournament section after adding participants.
tournament.ko.draw.manualCombinedDesc: Pairings are set after the Group Stage is completed with the qualified participants. Fillable round by round (save round 1, then round 2, …).
tournament.ko.draw.fixedCrossDesc: Group placements determine the pairings: A1 vs B2, B1 vs A2 (with 2 groups). No draw needed. Classic system for tournaments with a Group Stage.
tournament.ko.draw.samePositionCrossDesc: All group winners play against each other, all group runners-up likewise. Example: A1, B1, C1, D1 in one semifinal, A2, B2, C2, D2 in the other.
tournament.ko.draw.overallSeedingDesc: After the Group Stage, participants are seeded by overall performance and then paired (best vs. worst). Takes Group Stage results into account.
tournament.ko.draw.bonusDrawForWinnersDe: Group winners are specifically given an easier opponent in the first KO round (e.g. group winners vs. group runners-up/third-placed). Reward for Group Stage success.
tournament.ko.draw.predefinedBracketDesc: The KO bracket is already fixed. The Group Stage only determines which participants take which positions in the bracket. The structure is predefined.
tournament.ko.drawMode.randomFirst: a) First round random, then fixed bracket
tournament.ko.drawMode.randomFirstDesc: The first KO round is drawn randomly. From then on, the bracket stays fixed (classic bracket flow).
tournament.ko.drawMode.randomEachRoundDe: After each round, the winners are redrawn. Final without further draw.
tournament.ko.drawMode.predefinedSlots: c) Fixed bracket with slot designations
tournament.ko.drawMode.predefinedSlotsDe: The bracket is fixed from the start. Later rounds show only slot designations until the qualifiers are determined.
